tasks.goal: Issue #8: update URL-health probes so redirects to non-public HTTP(S) destinations are refused and marked manual_review rather than followed. Add mocked unit tests for redirection without making network requests; preserve candidate verification labels and normal valid redirect reporting.

Issue #8: make URL-health report distinguish transient DNS/timeouts/network failures from confirmed HTTP 404/410 broken links. Preserve no-publish-on-unverified behavior and add isolated tests. No real network during tests.

Issue #8: introduce an optional bounded maximum URL probe count for link-health checks, keeping deterministic ordering and truthful checked/unchecked totals in the JSON report. Add isolated tests; do not reclassify unprobed records as verified.

ROADMAP Stage 1: strengthen Massachusetts directory schema invariants with a focused defensive check and regression tests. Do not infer municipality service responsibility or mark records verified based on URL reachability.

ROADMAP Stage 1: add an accurate, separately labeled count of incomplete, stale, and unverified directory source candidates to coverage reporting, with deterministic regression tests. Do not suggest that a source is verified merely because reachable.
